digest.component_or_area: Module-size gate and repo-wide codebase refactoring
propositions: 46 Python files in src/rebar exceed 700 LOC, with 7 at/near the 800-LOC hard cap; headroom is exhausted repo-wide.
pass1.py (800 LOC) must be split: extract container-stage logic (~300 LOC) to container_stage.py, relocate _submit_ctx to generation.py to avoid import cycle and preserve ContextVar capture.
push.py (799 LOC) must be split: extract recovery cluster (B+C concerns, ~345 LOC) to push_recovery.py using core parameter late-binding pattern to preserve monkeypatch sites at 25 test locations.

A non-blocking CI module-size gate warning must surface files within 10% of the 800-LOC cap (near_cap_count metric, currently 37 files) without failing the build, using the gate's existing find|wc-l rule.
All re-exports must be byte-preserved so orchestrator.py, provider_parity.py, push_state.py, and _bridge_runner.py remain unchanged and patch sites continue working.

The existing near-cap leading indicator (module_size_distribution.near_cap_count) was reporting zero incorrectly due to scc/lizard installation and --by-file adapter bugs, now fixed; wiring it into CI is the residual work.
